title: Show the account as Teams, the top plan
description: Builds on 0003: changes plan to `teams`, the top organizational membership. Settings reads `Teams plan` and the plan card shows `Manage seats`; the Pro banner, Upgrade button and Teams upsell disappear. The relay still reports the real plan and meters; the team-owned computers, roles and device approval that Teams provides are server-side and are not created by this patch.
notes: Default. This is a client display change only. To show Pro instead of Teams, apply through 0003 and skip 0004.
